title: Lucknow Corridor Air Quality Benchmark Scenario

provenance.ingestion_lag_notice: Live real-time routing is out of scope due to upstream ~80h regulatory publishing latency.

weather_context.role: Macroscale ambient meteorological context only. Does not prove street-level dispersion.

stations.name: Gomti Nagar, Lucknow
stations.spatial_relation: Monitors the common route terminus at Gomti Nagar

stations.name: Lalbagh, Lucknow
stations.spatial_relation: Located ~450m from Route A Hazratganj arterial alignment

stations.name: Talkatora District Industries Center, Lucknow
stations.spatial_relation: Located 3.12 km west of Charbagh Railway Station; does NOT monitor route origin.

route_a.name: Route A — Hazratganj Arterial Corridor
route_a.corridor_description: Charbagh → Hussainganj → Hazratganj → 1090 Chauraha → Gomti Nagar

route_b.name: Route B — Cantonment Bypass Corridor
route_b.corridor_description: Charbagh → Cantt Road → Nehru Road → VIP Road → Gomti Nagar
route_b.unmonitored_disclosure: 88.5% of the Cantonment corridor has no nearby monitoring stations within a 1.0 km buffer. Zero synthetic extrapolation is applied.

methodology_notes.sampling: 50-meter equidistant polyline node sampling using Euclidean distance to nearest active monitor.
methodology_notes.limitations: Does not model microscale street canyons, roadside vehicle plumes, or cabin infiltration. Traffic congestion delays are unavailable and excluded.

disclaimer: This tool is an environmental scenario demonstration for hackathon evaluation. It provides relative ambient particulate observations and does not constitute medical, health, or travel safety advice.
